summary.text: Mike Levin is the Democratic incumbent in the 49th District, which includes North County San Diego and South Orange County, and has served in the U.S. House since January 2019.

An environmental attorney before Congress, he now serves on the House Appropriations Committee, and his official biography highlights clean energy, veterans' issues and the decommissioning of the San Onofre nuclear plant.

paragraphs.text: Levin was born in Inglewood, California, in 1978. According to his official biography, he was raised in South Orange County and attended Loyola High School in Los Angeles.

He earned a bachelor's degree in political science from Stanford University in 2001, where his official biography says he was student body president, and a J.D. from Duke University School of Law in 2005; he was also a Coro Fellow.

Levin worked as an attorney specializing in environmental and energy regulatory compliance and governmental affairs. He served as executive director of the Democratic Party of Orange County and on the board of the Center for Sustainable Energy and, according to his official biography, co-founded Sustain OC.
He won the open 49th District seat in November 2018, defeating Republican Diane Harkey 56.4% to 43.6%, and was re-elected in 2020.

In the 119th Congress (2025-2026) Levin serves on the House Appropriations Committee and its Energy and Water Development and Military Construction, Veterans Affairs subcommittees. Earlier he chaired the Veterans' Affairs Subcommittee on Economic Opportunity (2021-2022) and was its ranking member (2023-2024).

His official biography says more than 32 of his bills have been signed into law, including the Johnny Isakson and David P. Roe, M.D. Veterans Health Care and Benefits Improvement Act of 2020, and that he founded and co-chairs the Spent Nuclear Fuel Solutions Caucus.
It also says he belongs to the New Democrat Coalition, the Congressional Progressive Caucus and the Congressional Hispanic Caucus, and lives in San Juan Capistrano with his wife and two children.
